## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 4 sept 2026 - 4 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Anthony C_, 4 sept 2026, 1/5: "It does not synch sometimes to health connect it did not record my activity today. I even downloaded health sync and paid for the one time purchase subscription. still not synching. Even in Strava it sometimes does not sync, you have manually upload your activity which is a hassle. Been using Xiaomi Watch 5 during activity in the middle of the run it glitched and you have to start over again. Happened twice now in one month of use. I'm beginning to regret buying a Xiaomi watch too many issues."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 17 jul 2026 - 5 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Sayan B_, 5 sept 2026, 1/5: "Keeps logging me out and disconnecting from me watch without any notifications. Recently started getting this issue where it's disconnecting from my watch, keeps crashing and also disables the biometric authentication on other apps. Been using this app for 7 years, something recently just broke all functionality."
            2. _Anthony C_, 4 sept 2026, 1/5: "It does not synch sometimes to health connect it did not record my activity today. I even downloaded health sync and paid for the one time purchase subscription. still not synching. Even in Strava it sometimes does not sync, you have manually upload your activity which is a hassle. Been using Xiaomi Watch 5 during activity in the middle of the run it glitched and you have to start over again. Happened twice now in one month of use. I'm beginning to regret buying a Xiaomi watch too many issues."
            3. _Ariel Brnssn_, 2 ago 2026, 1/5: "Tiene algunos bug la app. No deja poner fotos en las caratulas"
